# Datasets behind the paper's results

<!-- generated by scripts/list_datasets.py; do not edit by hand -->

One row per dataset the benchmarks use. The source is quoted from the dataset guide of the benchmark. Size is the bytes of the files the benchmark reads, in GiB, with `.zip` and `.tar.gz` copies left out.

The last column names where the files come from and opens the "Get the data" section of the guide. The licences of the datasets are stated on the [Hugging Face repositories](https://huggingface.co/zenteiq-ai).

| Dataset | Benchmarks | Size | Files from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Darcy Flow 2D (operator-learning benchmark) | Darcy (data-driven and label-free) | 3.2 GiB | [Zenodo](../dataset_guide/darcy_2d.md#get-the-data) |
| Pipe (Geo-FNO pipe-flow benchmark) | Pipe | 1.5 GiB | [Geo-FNO data release](../dataset_guide/pipe.md#get-the-data) |
| Navier-Stokes, viscosity 1e-5 (`NavierStokes_V1e-5_N1200_T20.mat`) | Navier-Stokes | 393.8 MiB | [FNO data release](../dataset_guide/navier_stokes.md#get-the-data) |
| Lid-Driven Cavity, transient k-epsilon (OpenFOAM benchmark) | Cavity | 156.5 MiB | [Not public](../dataset_guide/cavity.md#get-the-data) |
| Chip Cooling / dual-chip liquid-cooled pin-fin cold plate CFD dataset (POD-NN benchmark) | Chip cooling | 1.3 GiB | [Dryad](../dataset_guide/chip_cooling.md#get-the-data) |
| AirfRANS (Airfoil RANS) | AirfRANS | 3.2 GiB | [airfrans package](../dataset_guide/airfrans.md#get-the-data) |
| Car-Design-ShapeNetCar (Transolver paper's car-surface/volume CFD benchmark) | ShapeNetCar | 3.9 GiB | [Umetani website](../dataset_guide/shapenetcar.md#get-the-data) |
| Car-CFD, "Three-dimensional flow dataset over ShapeNet-Car" (neuraloperator's processed version) | Car-CFD | 413.6 MiB | [Zenodo](../dataset_guide/car_cfd.md#get-the-data) |

## Darcy Flow 2D (operator-learning benchmark)

- **Source:** Li et al., *Fourier Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations*, ICLR 2021. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.08895>
- **Dataset guide:** `doc/dataset_guide/darcy_2d.md`

## Pipe (Geo-FNO pipe-flow benchmark)

- **Source:** Li et al., *Fourier Neural Operator with Learned Deformations for PDEs on General Geometries* (Geo-FNO), Journal of Machine Learning Research 24(388), 2023. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.05209> Wu et al., *Transolver: A Fast Transformer Solver for PDEs on General Geometries*, ICML 2024. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.02366>
- **Dataset guide:** `doc/dataset_guide/pipe.md`

## Navier-Stokes, viscosity 1e-5 (`NavierStokes_V1e-5_N1200_T20.mat`)

- **Source:** Li et al., *Fourier Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations*, ICLR 2021. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.08895> Wu et al., *Transolver: A Fast Transformer Solver for PDEs on General Geometries*, ICML 2024. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.02366>
- **Dataset guide:** `doc/dataset_guide/navier_stokes.md`

## Lid-Driven Cavity, transient k-epsilon (OpenFOAM benchmark)

- **Source:** Costa Rocha et al., *Deep Neural Network Modeling for CFD Simulations: Benchmarking the Fourier Neural Operator on the Lid-Driven Cavity Case*, Applied Sciences 13(5), 3165 (2023). <https://doi.org/10.3390/app13053165>
- **Dataset guide:** `doc/dataset_guide/cavity.md`

## Chip Cooling / dual-chip liquid-cooled pin-fin cold plate CFD dataset (POD-NN benchmark)

- **Source:** Curl and Hu, *Physically interpretable surrogate modeling of thermal fields in electronics cooling using combined proper orthogonal decomposition and neural networks*, AI Thermal Fluids 6, 100040 (2026). <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aitf.2026.100040>
- **Dataset guide:** `doc/dataset_guide/chip_cooling.md`

## AirfRANS (Airfoil RANS)

- **Source:** Bonnet et al., *AirfRANS: High Fidelity Computational Fluid Dynamics Dataset for Approximating Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes Solutions*, NeurIPS 2022, Datasets and Benchmarks. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.07564> Wu et al., *Transolver: A Fast Transformer Solver for PDEs on General Geometries*, ICML 2024. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.02366>
- **Dataset guide:** `doc/dataset_guide/airfrans.md`

## Car-Design-ShapeNetCar (Transolver paper's car-surface/volume CFD benchmark)

- **Source:** Umetani and Bickel, *Learning Three-Dimensional Flow for Interactive Aerodynamic Design*, ACM Transactions on Graphics 37(4), 2018. <https://doi.org/10.1145/3197517.3201325> Wu et al., *Transolver: A Fast Transformer Solver for PDEs on General Geometries*, ICML 2024. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.02366>
- **Dataset guide:** `doc/dataset_guide/shapenetcar.md`

## Car-CFD, "Three-dimensional flow dataset over ShapeNet-Car" (neuraloperator's processed version)

- **Source:** Umetani and Bickel, *Learning Three-Dimensional Flow for Interactive Aerodynamic Design*, ACM Transactions on Graphics 37(4), 2018. <https://doi.org/10.1145/3197517.3201325> Li et al., *Geometry-Informed Neural Operator for Large-Scale 3D PDEs*, NeurIPS 2023. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.00583>
- **Dataset guide:** `doc/dataset_guide/car_cfd.md`
